pricing:
As low as $29.68 with our weekday early bird special!

description: Our 2 person kayaks are a great way to experience the bay and get in a little exercise. It’s great for kids and there’s a lot to see and do around the bay. All our rentals come with lifejackets and our staff can point you in the right direction to go to see some sites and experience the bay.
highlights:
-Life vests included
-All vessels are required to stay within the bay
check_in_details:
Please arrive 30 minutes prior to your reservation time.
- Please make sure to open your confirmation email or text and fill out the waiver(s) prior to arrival at the location
- All Equipment must depart and return from the rental location
what_to_bring:
- Bring the credit card used to make the reservation and your matching ID
- Beverages and food if desired

what_to_bring_items.value: Bring the credit card used to make the reservation and your matching ID

special_requirements:
- We recommend wearing the provided life jackets regardless of your swimming abilities 
- Passengers under 13 years old must wear a lifejacket at all times
disclaimers:
Late arrivals could cut into your rental time.
Group Reservations larger than 12  people or 10 rental items require a 20% gratuity added into the reservation.
